text:
zoe.cs: Heads-up: NewWave reserved pool flip scheduled 07:30 PT tomorrow. Need final quota confirmation, autoscale policy signoff, and a tight smoke plan. Who can own the verification run?

pete.eng: I can run verification and validate autoscale. What SLOs are we aiming for?

zoe.cs: SLOs: p95 < 240ms, errors < 0.5%. Customer asked for a 20% surge headroom first 30m and explicit rollback steps. Also flag: renewal conversation next week so we want a smooth launch.

anya.ops: Quota layout: us-west-2a=48, us-west-2b=32, us-west-2c=20. Commit tag nw-commit-2026-03-25. Finance pre-approved a short +1 replica bump for up to 30m if needed; portal id quota-NW-77.

mark.sre: Recommend starting with autoscale policy "soft-start" (scale_step=1/60s) for first 15m to avoid JIT/GC thrash. We'll lower OOM thresholds and put a watch.

pete.eng: Plan two quick experiments:
- steady: 60% expected QPS for 12m
- burst-ramp: 0->100% in 3m, hold 8m, cool 7m
Runner: vegeta/k6 matrix depending on tests. Example command for vegeta:
```bash
echo 'POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' | vegeta attack -rate=220 -duration=12m | vegeta report
```

zoe.cs: Capture KV hit-rate, JIT/kernel logs, and quantized fallback switch latency. Upload artifacts to s3 and post link.

upload-bot: Artifact uploaded s3://redwood-ops/newwave/bringup/2111223334/steady-v1.tar.gz

pete.eng: Steady run results: p95=225ms, errors=0.28%, KV hit-rate=76%, avg CPU 71%. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/newwave/2111223334/steady-report.zip

pete.eng: Burst-ramp (soft-start) results: short cold window ~65s where p95 spiked to 460ms, then settled to 230ms. No OOMs. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/newwave/2111223334/ramp-soft-start.zip

pete.eng: Burst-ramp (burst policy) results: avoided cold-window but CPU spiked 92% on a host and we saw transient GC pauses; p95 peaked 340ms. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/newwave/2111223334/ramp-burst.zip

mark.sre: Observations: warm-replica (+1) removes cold-JIT penalty but costs ~12% more capacity during bump. Prefix priming reduces cold-window duration but doesn't fully eliminate JIT on first kernel invocation.

anya.ops: I can toggle prefix priming and pre-populate top prefixes before flip. If we choose warm-replica route, finance has pre-approval but we need to document duration.

zoe.cs: Tradeoff: minimize customer-visible blips for renewal. Recommendation: enable prefix priming + run soft-start autoscale for first 20m. Auto-fallback: spin +1 warm replica if p95>420ms for >45s. Priya ops to enable priming and add rollback steps to runbook.

anya.ops: Priming flag set in staging and prefixes preloaded. Rollback steps added: revert priming, spin warm replica, route 5-10% to quantized q8 fallback if needed. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/newwave-bringup

pete.eng: Final verification scheduled 06:50 PT, tagging @mark.sre for watch 07:15-08:15 PT. I'll upload final artifacts after run.

mark.sre: I'll monitor and lower OOM alerts for the window. Pager on-call during cutover.

zoe.cs: Thanks team  I'll update AE + customer with plan and confirm post-cutover status call at 10:00 PT. Closing loop after final verification.
